title: dangausakis.lt regional air-raid alert
description: Published BY bridges/vendors/dangausakis/dangausakis_bridge.py on every poll for each recent active alert, and once more with _delete=true when an alert leaves the feed. Alerts have an area name but no coordinates, so this is a status message, not a track.

_src.description: Where the alert was read: the site's aggregated feed or a direct upstream.

country.description: Upper-case country code: LT, LV, PL, EE or UA.

level.description: Upstream severity label, e.g. red or orange.

notify.description: False for zone-only entries (e.g. NEPTUN districts, per-county copies of a nationwide alert); tak_alert_layer sends no GeoChat for them. Absent means true.

reason.description: Upstream reason text when the source gives one (NEPTUN).

stale.description: True when the upstream source for this country is flagged stale; the layer will not alert on it.

_delete.description: Present only on the one-shot cleared variant.
